{{Top|leg}}
The '''Guardian Holds''' were a series of fortified bases on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], designed so that as long as the Republic held the holds, Corellia could be retaken. However, various people within the holds were actually [[Children of the Emperor|Children of the Emperor,]] Sith sleeper agents, who, upon being signaled to by the [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]], took the holds over.
